drop.title: Drop a PDF here
drop.subtitle: or click to browse · nothing is uploaded, ever

organize.hint: Drag pages to reorder. Use the buttons on each page to rotate or delete it.

merge.hint: Add more PDFs and drag their pages into order. Everything ends up in one file.

split.rangesHint: e.g. 1-3, 5, 8-10 · each range becomes a file
split.preview: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} will be created
split.invalid: Check the ranges: pages must be between 1 and {max}.
split.single: Single PDF of the selected ranges

sign.hint: Draw your signature below, then drag it onto the page.
sign.uploadHint: PNG with a transparent background works best.
sign.placed: Signature placed on page {n}. Drag it to move.

compress.hint: Embedded photos are re-encoded as JPEG. Text and vectors are untouched.
compress.result: {count, plural, =0 {No images could be re-encoded} one {# image re-encoded} other {# images re-encoded}}
compress.unsupported: This browser can't re-encode images in the background. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari 16.4+.

export.doneSplit: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} ready
export.eta: Working on-device · nothing leaves your computer
export.encrypted: This PDF is password-protected. Remove the password first.
export.corrupt: This file doesn't look like a valid PDF.

confirm.clearBody: All pages and settings in this session will be discarded. Nothing has been uploaded, so there is nothing to recover.
confirm.deleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}?
confirm.deleteBody: You can restore the original order, but deleted pages come back only by reopening the file.

images.title: Images to PDF
images.dropSubtitle: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC · one image per page
images.unsupported: “{name}” couldn't be decoded by this browser.
